blocks.heading: First-Time Customer Guide
blocks.lead: Whether you're new to cannabis or just new to High Society Cannabis in New Buffalo, we make your first visit easy and welcoming.

items.title: Check In
items.md: Recreational customers must be 21 or older, while medical patients 18+ with a valid medical card are also welcome. When you arrive, have your government-issued ID or passport ready and check in with our friendly security and front desk staff.

items.title: Stay in the Loop
items.md: You’ll be asked to provide your phone number and email so you can stay in the loop about exclusive promotions and special offers.

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: When it's your turn, a knowledgeable budtender will invite you in from the waiting area to help you browse products, answer your questions, and guide you through the shopping process—whether you're a first-timer or a regular.

items.title: Choose Your Items
items.md: Once you've made your selection, the budtender will pass your order to our preparation team. We accept payments via cash, credit, or debit.

items.title: Complete Your Purchase
items.md: When your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process your payment, and confirm all details to ensure accuracy before completing the sale.

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Browse the Menu
items.md: Start by browsing our [online menu](/shop/new-buffalo/) or give us a call at [(269) 231-5213](tel:+12692315213) if you need help choosing the right products.

items.title: Build Your Order
items.md: Once you've found your favorites, select the quantity, add items to your cart, and choose a pick-up time that works for you.

items.title: Check Out
items.md: To complete your order, enter your details at checkout. First-time customers will need to show a valid government-issued ID when picking up, while returning customers can log in for a quicker experience.

items.title: Curbside Pickup
items.md: Prefer curbside pickup? Just let us know during checkout—we’ll send you a text when your order is ready for easy and discreet collection.

items.title: Enjoy Responsibly
items.md: Enjoy responsibly—we’re here to make your cannabis shopping experience smooth, safe, and stress-free!

items.q: What are the requirements to shop at High Society Cannabis New Buffalo?
items.a: To shop at our dispensary, you must present a valid government-issued ID confirming you are 21 or older. Medical patients 18+ with a valid medical card are also welcome.

items.q: What should I do if I receive a defective product?
items.a: If you experience issues with a product's quality or functionality, please call us at [(269) 231-5213](tel:+12692315213) or visit the store where you made the purchase. Our team is happy to help.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept at your dispensary?
items.a: High Society accepts cash and debit cards. Many locations also feature an in-store ATM for your convenience. Some stores may offer additional payment options—call ahead for details.

items.q: Is it legal to transport cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan, but transporting cannabis across state lines is prohibited under federal law. Avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What products are available at the dispensary?
items.a: We offer a wide range of high-quality products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Check out our menu or contact us with specific inquiries.

items.q: Do you have a loyalty program for customers?
items.a: Absolutely! Join The Society, our loyalty program, to start earning points on your purchases. Points can be redeemed for exclusive discounts and offers. Speak to our staff for more information.
